result.text:
After 7 years, I’ve made the difficult decision to leave X. Over the years, I’ve helped rebuild the Business and Product from the ground up with a fraction of the original Twitter team, across many significant changes and many long nights of war rooms—scaling many multiples in product revenue, contributing to the early days of xAI, establishing our existing and future partners, supporting the early days of @bot with X, and reinvigorating our Developer Platform as the Everything API for the next generation of agents and developers.

Thank you @elonmusk for giving me a chance to thrive as an extreme operator, @jack for hiring me, and our incredible @X engineers and team, who will carry this mission forward as the global town square.🫡❤️
